objective: Generate offline Python applications for Gaussian linewidth and Curie fitting. Measure peak-to-peak width and resonance center in an isolated CW-EPR derivative line.
behavior: Return center_mT as the midpoint of the fields at maximum and minimum signal, and linewidth_mT as their absolute field separation. Accept either field_mT or field_G with matching metadata (1 G = 0.1 mT). Also return peak_mT and trough_mT.
review: Confirm an isolated, well-resolved line and inspect baseline and field calibration.
